mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS r_id, r.result_id AS r_result_id, r.field_key AS r_field_key, r.rep_no AS r_rep_no, r.value AS r_value, r.unit AS r_unit, CASE r.rep_no WHEN 1 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN 2 THEN 'Good' WHEN 3 THEN 'Normal' WHEN 4 THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS r_level, ind.evaluation_direction AS ind_dir FROM apms_test_result_rep r LEFT JOIN apms_test_result res ON r.result_id = res.id LEFT JOIN apms_indicator ind ON ind.id = COALESCE(res.indicator_id, (SELECT ti.indicator_id FROM apms_task_item ti WHERE ti.id = res.task_item_id)) WHERE r.result_id = #{resultId} ORDER BY r.field_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_test_result_rep (result_id, field_key, rep_no, value, unit) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{fieldKey}, #{repNo}, #{value}, #{unit})
